title: Battle Monsters
overview:
There's a Rumble in Hell... and You're Invited.

Twelve psychotic monsters fight fist-and-fang in the darkest, goriest head-to-head combat ever! In bone-chilling interactive, multi-levelled environments, the beasts of the undead trade clawfuls of sickening supermoves in their bid to rule the underworld. Overflowing with blood, guts, drool and slime, Battle Monsters is mangling multi-hit, mid-air fighting with super-fast scaling, chopping, stabbing, gouging and morphing. Feeling lucky, freak?
